title: 공손하게 거절하기: “좀 어려울 것 같아요”
objective: You can find the reason and the alternative in a polite Korean refusal and tell whether a soft reply means yes or no.
summary: This worksheet shows how Koreans say no politely.
note: All dialogues are short, everyday examples of refusing invitations, offers, and requests at work and with friends.

task.title: Read and decode refusals
task.line: Read each Korean reply, then find the information, judge the meaning, or write a softer version.

sections.heading: Four parts of a polite no

items.text: Thank the person first so the no feels softer.
items.example: 말씀은 감사하지만 오늘은 먼저 들어가 볼게요.

items.text: Use it before a refusal to show you feel bad about saying no.
Giving only the reason often works as the refusal itself.

items.gloss: it seems a bit hard to
items.text: It means no, but sounds much softer than 못 해요.
items.example: 이번 주 안에 끝내기가 좀 어려울 것 같아요.

items.text: It politely turns down food, drinks, or help someone offers you.
Use it to politely turn down a gift or a favor.
It often means a soft no rather than a real maybe.
items.example: 지금 바로 결정하기는 어려워서요. 생각해 볼게요.

items.text: It offers another chance so the other person does not feel rejected.
items.example: 오늘은 어렵고, 다음에 꼭 같이 가요.

sections.heading: Culture tip: reading between the lines

points.lead: In many countries, a clear “No, thanks” is polite
In Korean, 싫어요 or 안 돼요 alone can sound cold
That's why Koreans often give a reason and leave the no unsaid, as in 금요일 밤은 약속이 있어서요
When you read a reply, look for the reason (-아서요) and the alternative (다음에), then decide if it means yes or no

exercises: Read and answer in English: What is 나 (B)'s reason, and what does 나 (B) suggest instead? — 가: 이번 토요일에 등산 같이 갈래요? 나: 같이 가자고 해 줘서 고마워요. 그런데 토요일에는 동생 이사를 도와줘야 해서요. 다음 달에 같이 가요.
Does the speaker accept (Yes) or refuse (No)?: ① 마음만 감사히 받을게요. ② 좋아요, 몇 시에 만날까요? ③ 이번에는 좀 힘들 것 같아요. ④ 그럼 저도 한 잔만 할게요.
Fill in the blank with a polite way to decline the offer: 가: 커피 한 잔 더 드릴까요? 나: 아니요, 저는 ____. 충분히 마셨어요.
Put the sentences in the order of a polite refusal (thanks → reason → refusal → alternative): (가) 다음 주에는 시간이 될 것 같아요. (나) 초대해 주셔서 감사해요. (다) 이번 주는 출장이 있어서요. (라) 이번에는 못 갈 것 같아요.
Rewrite this direct refusal more softly, using -기가 좀 어려울 것 같아요: 금요일까지 보고서를 못 보내요.
answers: Reason: B has to help a younger sibling move house on Saturday. Suggestion: go hiking together next month.
① No ② Yes ③ No ④ Yes
금요일까지 보고서를 보내기가 좀 어려울 것 같아요. (보내기 좀 어려울 것 같아요 / 보내기가 좀 어려울 것 같습니다)
